definition: INTERRUPT n (Shade): when the opponent plays a card, play this from your hand at once to cancel that card's effect.
window: The opponent's turn, right after they place a card, before it resolves.
does: Cancels one effect; the Shade joins your Line, gains its Glow, and its Ward applies.
does_not: Cannot target an Unstoppable card. Cannot itself be interrupted. Does not chain. Does not take a turn.

contrast.ward: Interrupt acts and cancels any one effect; Ward waits and blocks only Dim.
contrast.stop_time: Interrupt acts on the opponent's turn; Stop Time extends your own.
contrast.cancel: Interrupt is the action; Cancel is its result.
